tools.name: get_billing_usage
tools.description: Get SingleStore billing usage for a time range, optionally for one metric and aggregated by hour, day or month

start_time.description: Start of the usage interval, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z)

end_time.description: End of the usage interval, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-09-12T00:00:00Z)

metric.description: Optional metric to report (default: all metrics)

aggregate_by.description: Optional aggregation bucket for the usage rows

needs_review: AUTH UNCHANGED from the scaffold: the SingleStore Management API takes the API key as a plain bearer token, and the blind probe confirms it (401 'invalid API Key, wrong format: encoding/hex: invalid byte: U+0051 Q' — the key is read as hex, so the header name and scheme are right and only the value is wrong).

READ-ONLY by design: all ten tools are GETs, no tool is marked write:true. Workspace create/resume/suspend/terminate and starter-workspace creation are deliberately absent: they spend money and destroy data, so they need a cost-guard and approval design before they ship.
/v1/secrets is deliberately NOT wired even though it answers (401): the Secrets object carries the secret VALUE itself, and a read tool that hands an agent decrypted org secrets is the wrong default.

Every path in this spec was route-checked blind against api.singlestore.com: the Go mux answers an unrouted path with 404 'page not found' BEFORE the auth middleware, so a 401 proves the route exists. /v1/regions/v2, /v1/stage, /v1/starter/workspaces, /v1/organizations/current/users, /v1/organizations/current/invitations and /v1/workspaceGroups/{id}/backups all returned 404 and were dropped; /v1/privateConnections and /v1/jobs answered 405 'method not allowed (indicate one of POST)', so they have no GET and were dropped too.

Response picks are documentation-derived, not data-verified: a dummy key never yields a success body. Field names come from SingleStore's own Python SDK deserialisers (singlestoredb/management/workspace.py, region.py, organization.py, billing_usage.py), which is why list_workspace_groups carries allowAllTraffic but no state, and the billing rows are billingUsage[].Usage[] with the capitalised Usage key the API actually sends.

test moved from /v1/workspaceGroups (scaffolded) to /v1/organizations/current: both answer, but the organization read needs no resources to exist, so it is the honest credential check for a brand-new org.
docs/tools_source point at the Management API reference rather than the registry's docs root, which is the product documentation home and carries no endpoint detail.
